scoring_justification: Compare agent‑reported B3LYP dipole moments and O···X distances to the paper’s Table 1 and text values using tolerances of 0.05 Debye and 0.02 Å. This is a deterministic computational reproduction; the paper’s numbers serve as hidden gold.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold B3LYP dipole moments (Debye) for compounds 1–9, ax‑ax and eq‑eq conformers
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from Table 1 into an inline dictionary keyed by (compound, conformer).
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the exact published numbers for the B3LYP functional; the task aims to reproduce them.

hidden_assets.purpose: Gold O···X distances (Å) for the ax‑ax conformer of compounds 1–9
hidden_assets.generation_method: Direct transcription from the paper into an inline dictionary keyed by compound.
hidden_assets.why_not_fabricated: The values are the exact published distances; the task aims to reproduce them.

outputs.description: Dipole moments for each compound and conformer (ax-ax, eq-eq) at B3LYP/6-311+g** level. The checker compares these values to the paper’s reported B3LYP dipole moments.
O···X interatomic distances for the ax-ax conformer of each compound, computed from B3LYP/6-311+g** optimized geometries. The checker compares these distances to the paper’s reported values.

output_contract.notes: Use the B3LYP functional with the 6-311+g** basis set; for iodine atoms employ the 3-21g basis set. Only the total dipole moment is required; do not include HF or MP2 dipole moments. The agent is free to use any open-source quantum chemistry package (e.g., ORCA).
